visibleDefectCandidate.observation: F2 retains similar split-foot silhouette to F0: one boot low and the opposite boot raised laterally. F6 likewise retains a similar split-foot silhouette to F4. At game size the two passing keys are weakly distinct from their preceding contact keys.
visibleDefectCandidate.implication: Prioritize clear passing under the pelvis and receiving-weight phase rather than repainting identity or all eight frames.
visibleDefectCandidate.limitations: No measured support intervals or anatomical landmark continuity; cannot assert foot slide, contact error, seam failure or physical-side assignment from stills.

A.provisionalIdentity: Leg receiving weight at legacy F0 contact intent

B.provisionalIdentity: Opposite leg receiving weight at legacy F4 contact intent

repairPriority.wholePoseControl: Keep original whole character/camera/canvas/pivot/equipment. A receives/supports weight; B swings through beneath the pelvis, knee flexed, swing boot clear of ground. Make passing read distinctly from F0 split-foot contact. Keep natural small counter-swing and body weight shift; do not freeze upper body. Preserve physical leg continuity through F1/F3.

Opposite weight transfer: B receives/supports weight; A passes beneath pelvis with flexed knee and clear swing boot. Distinct from F4 split-foot contact. Preserve physical leg continuity through F5/F7; do not mirror F2.

changedControl.method: Exact Villager D1 source-bound whole-frame edits of passing keys with explicit support/swing and receiving-weight intents; preserve valid contacts and whole original appearance anchor. Root must approve persistent leg mapping and a whole-clothed guide before any finite order.
changedControl.reasonGuideDeferred: Anatomical/persistent A/B assignment uncertain. Drawing arbitrary landmark coordinates would conceal that uncertainty.

changedControl.distinctionFromClosedInfantry: Different identity/action-direction pilot with existing Villager sources; this does not reopen Infantry482/483/486 or reset any consumed budget. Distinction is not proof edit control will work.
